name: Edens Hawaii – Hawaiian Clothing Manufacturer
old_description: My husband has worn aloha shirts exclusively in warm weather since 1970. The shirts need to be only two colors, all cotton, with a pocket, and made in Hawaii. This beautiful shirt has become his new favorite. It arrived very quickly, and emotes the spirit of aloha. Thank you Edens Hawaii.
about:
Edens Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, producing tropical apparel that includes muumuu dresses, aloha shirts, matching family and couples outfits, and hula skirts. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public sources, and no founders are named.

The brand manufactures its garments in Hawaii, emphasizing local production across its product line. Items are described as made from cotton and rayon fabrics, with styles ranging from traditional hibiscus prints to wedding dresses and coordinated family sets. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Edens Hawaii serves retail consumers seeking authentic Hawaiian clothing and also markets "unique Hawaiian uniforms" for teams, workwear, and special events. Customer reviews highlight purchases of dresses, shirts, and matching outfits for personal use, weddings, and family occasions.

The company positions its Hawaii-based manufacturing as a core differentiator, with buyers noting well-made construction, quality fabric, prompt shipping, and responsive communication. These attributes are presented as the reasons customers return and recommend the brand.
